intro:
JALECOlle Famicom revives JALECO classics!
Vol. 8: ROD LAND Includes the original Japanese version in this 2-in-1 release!
description:
Rescue Mama from Maboots Tower!
Grab enemies with Magic Rods and create ladders with special shoes.
A stage-clearing action game for 1 or 2 players.

◆Game Story

Tam and Rit, two fairy siblings, lived peacefully with their Mama in Fairy Village.

But one day, a huge ghost kidnapped their mother and took her away to Maboots Tower.

To save Mama, the two set off for the tower with their magical rods and special shoes.

Their main attack is to use the rods’ magic to grab enemies and slam them into the ground.

The special shoes also let them create and climb ladders.

Cross otherwise unreachable platforms, collect items placed high above, and discover new ways through each stage!

Defeated enemies can leave behind attack items, allowing you to take them down in all kinds of ways.

Collect every flower in a stage, and the remaining enemies will transform into special EXTRA GAME enemies.

Defeat them to make EXTRA items appear!

Collect EXTRA items to earn 1UPs and high-score bonuses.

Play solo or team up in 2-player co-op!

Guide Tam and Rit to the top of Maboots Tower and rescue Mama!


◆Customize Your Game with Options!

The options menu, available from the title screen,
includes settings for 2-player play with Tam and Rit.

Choose Friendly play, share points between both players,
or compete in Rival mode, where you can interfere with your opponent.

The Jump setting can also dramatically change the way you play.
Choose from No Jump, Normal Jump, or jumps that hit overhead platforms.
(Normal Jump is selected by default.)

Customize player colors, hints, music, and sound effects.
You can also choose the title screen BGM, adjust demo speed,
register player names, and more!

Set up ROD LAND your way!


◆JALECOlle Famicom Series: New Features

★Beginner-Friendly Assist Features
Use intuitive Rewind controls to instantly retry after a mistake,
or save and resume your game from anywhere
with Quick Save & Load.

★Helpful Subtitle Guide
Supports the Japanese localization.

★Record Your Best Time
Track your time from the start of your adventure
to defeating the final boss with the Simple Timer.

Use Quick Save to chase your best time,
or take on the game without any assist features at all.
Set your personal best!

★Plus, plenty of extras and options!
・Achievements to challenge a variety of goals
・An Extra Page featuring original package art, manuals, flyers, and more
・A Screen Edge option to reduce distortion at the edges of the screen
・Screen Filter options
・Wallpaper options
・Clear bonuses featuring a little extra content after completing the main game
